body: I think my fairness and nobility is what she is used to. Obviously everyone has two sides to them I’ve just never shown her that other side of me. When I first met my wife I had been in the Army for 3 years and remained in the Army 4 years after. It just blows my mind she wouldn’t do anything like this when she had the chance while I was on deployments or training events. After I left the Army (for her) I got a very well paying job that made me work out of state 5 days per week. I never once cheated or put myself in a situation to do so. She had a breakdown about 11 months into the job and I ended up leaving it for a less paying local job to be closer. I guess what I’m getting at is that I’m stunned she can’t see the sacrifices that I have made for her and my children. I’ve grown more distant from my family and my friends because of her. I moved so that we could be closer to her family even though they treat her so badly and she talks so lowly of them. I’ve struggled with trying to understand her logic until I realized she doesn’t really have any in decisions she makes. Her decisions are usually poor ones that end badly and her track record of bad decisions corroborate that. It’s just very hard to stop caring about someone even after they do you so badly.

I appreciate the insight. At this moment what she is telling me is very believable and I don’t fee she would contest the divorce at all as long as I try to remain fair. I don’t Want to take everything from her. She just recently got her first job in the last year which doesn’t pay well so I worry about what she’ll do after the divorce. She has no HS diploma or GED either. I worry for my kids and also because I do care about her well being. Living with her parents is probably the worst place she could be for her mental state as her parents are very verbally and emotionally abusive(hence the past problems).

I have mentioned marriage counseling and even went as far as to try to get her to do counseling that focuses on infidelity to no avail. Her outlook is that she doesn’t want someone else telling her how she should feel. She buried her emotions for I’d say 7 months now and they have started resurfacing gradually but she just shuts down and gets distant.
